text:
miguel.s: FYI crashed a sample-app flow because we rely on error.message text == 'Unauthorized' to trigger refresh. Node SDK returned ApiError('unauthorized') with http 401 but missing machine code.

ashley.k: Yikes. We should stop message matching. Proposal: add `error_code` string (e.g., "auth.expired", "perm.missing_scope", "rate.limited") on error objects in addition to http_status and typed subclasses.

zoe: Love error_code idea. Machine-readable code helps long-lived integrations and telemetry. Also include `human_hint` for quickstart copy.

miguel.s: parity note: make sure same fields + names in Py/JS/Go. Keep ApiError base to avoid breakage. Add a minor shim that sets error.error_code from message for one release.

ashley.k: Also add a short sample-app snippet showing recommended handling (check instanceof / error_code / http_status). Add a lint in sample-apps to discourage string-match.

ops-bot: created DE-2150: "sdk: add error_code + parity + sample-app updates" assigned to @zoe.

zoe: I'll draft RFC and sample snippet. Will include migration notes and unit tests. Ping me for review.
